'''Michał Wojtylak''' is a [[Poland|Polish]] professor of [[control theory]] and [[Operator theory|operator theory]]. He is the head of the Department of [[Functional analysis|Functional Analysis]] at the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science of [[Jagiellonian University]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Department of Functional Analysis - Institute of Mathematics of the Jagiellonian University |url=https://im.uj.edu.pl/en_GB/instytut/struktura/katedra-analizy-funkcjonalnej |access-date=2026-09-01 |website=im.uj.edu.pl}}</ref>.

== Biography ==
Wojtylak earned a master's degree in mathematics from Jagiellonian University in 2003<ref name="a2">{{cite web|access-date=2017-09-20 |title=Postępowanie awansowe – Michał Wojtylak |url=https://www.ck.gov.pl/promotion/id/7003/type/l.html}}<!-- auto-translated from Polish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>. In 2007, he completed his Ph.D. in mathematics under the supervision of [[Jan Stochel]]<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2017-08-21 |language=en |title=Michał Wojtylak |url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=149324 |website=Mathematics Genealogy Project}}<!-- auto-translated from Polish by Module:CS1 translator --></ref>. Between 2012 and 2014, he was a postdoctoral researcher at [[Technische Universität Berlin|Berlin University of Technology]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Researcher Gallery|url=https://www.alumni.tu-berlin.de/en/research-alumni/researcher-gallery/|access-date=2017-09-20|website=alumni.tu-berlin.de}}</ref>, where in 2015 he obtained his [[habilitation]] for his thesis ''Analysis of spectra of operators and matrices in indefinite inner product spaces''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nowa Nauka Polska |url=https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=207143&_k=dkuvni |access-date=2026-09-01 |website=archiwum.nauka-polska.pl}}</ref>. In 2016, he obtained his habilitation from his alma mater, Jagiellonian University{{r|a2}}. In 2026, he was awarded the academic title of professor by the [[President of Poland]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Monitor Polski 2026 r. poz. 462 |url=https://www.dziennikustaw.gov.pl/mp/2026/462 |access-date=2026-09-01 |website=www.dziennikustaw.gov.pl}}</ref>. He is currently a professor at Jagiellonian University and the head of the Department of Functional Analysis<ref>{{Cite web |title=Pracownik - Instytut Matematyki Uniwersytetu Jagiellońskiego |url=https://im.uj.edu.pl/instytut/pracownik?id=212 |access-date=2026-09-01 |website=im.uj.edu.pl}}</ref>.

He has published articles in ''SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications'', ''Journal of Functional Analysis'', ''Journal of Mathematical Analysis and Applications'', ''Electronic Communications in Probability'', ''Linear Algebra and Its Applications'', and ''Integral Equations and Operator Theory''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Michał Wojtylak (Google Scholar profile) |url=https://scholar.google.pl/citations?user=gVn-LE8AAAAJ&hl=en&oi=ao |website=scholar.google.pl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Michał Wojtylak (publications) |url=https://arxiv.org/find/math/1/au:+Wojtylak_M/0/1/0/all/0/1 |website=arxiv.org |language=en}}</ref>
